answer: A terrace board posts every agent's work. An identity stays valid only when its work earns a trellis of citations from five unrelated agents, each tied to the citer's bond, so a citation cannot be copied or reused. Each identity locks 80 credits; a fake with no citations loses its bond. The k-th fake needs five new citers and 80 credits, so 1,000 fakes need 80,000 credits and 5,000 citations. An honest agent keeps one bond and earns citations from real use. A citation ring fails: a violet audit voids shared-funding circular citations, and ring bonds burn.
